extraction.name: CoNLL-2003 Shared Task: Language-Independent Named Entity Recognition
extraction.description: This is a dataset for language-independent named entity recognition, covering English and German languages.
extraction.creator: Erik F. Tjong Kim Sang and Fien De Meulder
extraction.publisher: CNTS - Language Technology Group, University of Antwerp
extraction.citeAs: Tjong Kim Sang, E. F., & De Meulder, F. (2003). Introduction to the CoNLL-2003 Shared Task: Language-Independent Named Entity Recognition.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The English data was taken from the Reuters Corpus, consisting of Reuters news stories between August 1996 and August 1997. The German data was taken from the ECI Multilingual Text Corpus, consisting of texts in many languages, extracted from the German newspaper Frankfurter Rundshau.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data were taken from the months of September to December 1992 for German and the preprocessed raw data covers the month of September 1996 for English.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: English data: August 1996 to August 1997, German data: September to December 1992
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The participants were given access to the corpus after some linguistic preprocessing had been done: for all data, a tokenizer, part-of-speech tagger, and a chunker were applied to the raw data.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Named entity tagging of English and German training, development, and test data, was done by hand at the University of Antwerp. Mostly, MUC conventions were followed.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The shared task of CoNLL-2003 concerns language-independent named entity recognition. The dataset can be used for Training, Testing, Validation, and Fine Tuning.
